verdict.rationale: Datalab's only event-driven mechanism is webhooks. They send real-time notifications when processing jobs complete, and the webhook URL can be overridden per request. Pipelines chain processors into reusable configurations, but nothing shows they run automatically on events, so any rule-based automation has to be built outside Datalab on top of webhook callbacks. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger rules or conditions, event types beyond job completion, automatic actions such as running a pipeline on file upload, and any independent corroboration.
